events.event_name: JSM Beauty x Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Mobile route: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21-27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile K-beauty and ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch, with stops on Lexington Avenue, in SoHo, and in Meatpacking.
events.what_is_free: Guests can receive a special JSM Beauty x Van Leeuwen ice cream by following @jsmbeauty_global. A social-post giveaway offers a chance to receive a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Free ice cream requires following JSM Beauty on Instagram. The full-size lip-serum opportunity requires tagging/sharing and is limited to 200 units per day. Exact Lexington Avenue street number is not stated in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: Lexington 11 AM-1 PM; 557 Broadway 1:30-3:30 PM; 21-27 9th Ave 4-7 PM. Sept. 20: same first two stops; Meatpacking 4-6 PM.

events.what_it_is: Credo Beauty's two-day reopening celebration for its revamped SoHo boutique, with gifting, giveaways, raffles and shopping.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary. Product raffles are also no-purchase-required. A separate event-exclusive gift requires a $100+ in-store purchase.
events.caveats: Credo explicitly says RSVP is not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Complimentary first-150 gifts are first-come, first-served and while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19: 11 AM-7 PM. Sunday Sept. 20: 11 AM-6 PM. Arrive early for the first-150 no-purchase gift.

events.what_it_is: Heaven Mayhem's first U.S. retail pop-up, a three-day accessories shopping experience at Shopify NY.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free. Gifts with purchase are advertised; the free-matcha offer was limited to the first 100 guests on opening day Sept. 18 and should not be expected on Sept. 19-20.
events.caveats: The official brand page confirms Sept. 18-20 and 131 Greene St but does not publish daily hours in its indexed text. A current event listing gives 11 AM-6 PM on Sept. 19 and 20. Do not advertise opening-day-only free matcha for later dates.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 and Sept. 20 hours are 11 AM-6 PM according to the current event listing corroborating the official brand page.

events.event_name: LoveShackFancy Just a Girl Fragrance Suite
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 14th Street & 9th Avenue, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A Paris-inspired fragrance activation for LoveShackFancy's Just a Girl Eau de Parfum, with a fragrance concierge, sample, passport-photo moment and purchase-linked gifts.
events.what_is_free: Free RSVP and a free fragrance sample are advertised. The first 10 people in line receive a special gift. Passport-holder and travel-spray-holder gifts require a qualifying $125 LoveShackFancy fragrance purchase at Sephora.
events.caveats: The verified listing advertises a free RSVP but the indexed source does not expose the destination registration URL. Do not present the purchase-linked gifts as free without purchase.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon-4 PM at Chelsea Triangle. First 10 in line receive a special gift; other purchase-linked gifts have a $125 Sephora fragrance spend requirement.

events.event_name: La Mer Ice Cream Party at Bloomingdale's SoHo
events.what_it_is: A La Mer beauty-counter activation during Bloomingdale's fall programming, pairing complimentary ice cream with a personalized Skin by La Mer experience.
events.what_is_free: A complimentary ice cream treat and a complimentary sample of the new Concentrate are advertised.
events.caveats: The Bloomingdale's corporate release confirms La Mer ice cream-cart activations on Sept. 19; current NYC event sources identify the SoHo location and 2-6 PM window. Complimentary items remain subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2-6 PM at Bloomingdale's SoHo, 504 Broadway.

events.event_name: Step Up for Fashion on Madison Avenue
events.address: Madison Avenue, East 57th to East 86th Streets, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: The third annual public Madison Avenue fashion initiative benefiting the CFDA Scholarship Fund, with more than 50 participating retailers, student-designer displays, meet-and-greets and sidewalk hospitality.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the avenue-wide programming, including sidewalk activities, fashion presentations and advertised hospitality such as flowers, beverages, treats and surprises. Purchases are optional; participating stores donate 10% of sales to the scholarship fund.
events.caveats: This is a district-wide public shopping/fashion program rather than one single storefront activation. Individual store offers and inventory vary.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM-6 PM along Madison Avenue from East 57th to East 86th Streets and adjacent side streets.
